text: かざんの　そばには　おんせんが　つきものじゃ　この　ともしびおんせんは　わしが　むかし　おおきな　いわを　ほりぬいて　つくったのじゃヨ　そのとき　つかっていた　これを　やろうかナ

structure.jp: かざんの　そばには
おんせんが　つきものじゃ
この　ともしびおんせんは
わしが　むかし　おおきな　いわを　ほりぬいて
structure.en: long ago I dug through a huge rock and

structure.jp: そのとき　つかっていた　これを
structure.en: this, which I was using then
shall I give it to you, I wonder

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ, which gives the feel of explaining how things are. つくったのじゃ = 'I made it, you see'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そのとき　つかっていた　これ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. そのとき　つかっていた　これ = 'this, which I was using at that time'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: The おう ending means 'I'll do it' or 'let's', and か after it makes it a wondering 'shall I?'. やろうかナ = 'shall I give it to you, I wonder'.
